Bumps [actions/setup-node](https://github.com/actions/setup-node) from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/setup-node's releases.

v7.1.0

What's Changed

Enhancements:

  • Add support for mise.toml file by @​gperdomor in actions/setup-node#1421
  • Support absolute paths in node-version-file by @​v-mahabaleshwars in actions/setup-node#1633

Bug fixes:

  • Add Node version validation and manifest fetch retry by @​v-jitenderpalsingh in actions/setup-node#1580

Documentation updates:

  • README.md: bump actions/checkout to latest version 7 by @​deining in actions/setup-node#1578
  • docs: add V7 ESM migration and NODE_AUTH_TOKEN behavior change by @​v-gowridurgad in actions/setup-node#1593
  • Fixed cache recommendation syntax by @​SubJunk in actions/setup-node#1603

Dependency updates:

  • Update workflow pins and migrate Node matrices to modern versions by @​v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-node#1583
  • Upgrade @​actions/cache to 6.2.0 by @​philip-gai in actions/setup-node#1584
  • Pin @​types/node to v24 by @​v-priyagupta108 in actions/setup-node#1585
  • Override brace-expansion to 5.0.8 by @​v-priyagupta108 with @​Copilot in actions/setup-node#1599
  • Upgrade actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1598
  • Upgrade prettier from 3.8.4 to 3.9.6 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1590
  • Upgrade @​vercel/ncc from 0.44.0 to 0.45.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1610

  • Upgrade baseline-browser-mapping from 2.10.38 to 2.11.22 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1629
  • Upgrade @​types/semver from 7.7.1 to 7.8.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1616
  • Upgrade @​typescript-eslint/parser from 8.62.0 to 8.70.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1615

  • Upgrade jest-each from 30.4.1 to 30.5.2 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1636
  • Upgrade eslint-plugin-n from 18.1.0 to 18.3.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1638
  • Update dependencies and add license files by @​v-HarithaVattikuti in actions/setup-node#1642
  • Upgrade eslint from 10.5.0 to 10.11.0 and package.json from 7.0.0 to 7.1.0 by @​dependabot in actions/setup-node#1635

New Contributors

  • @​v-jitenderpalsingh made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1580
  • @​philip-gai made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1584
  • @​gperdomor made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1421
  • @​SubJunk made their first contribution in actions/setup-node#1603
